notes.title: LURKS WITHIN WALLS Demo Coming to Steam Next Fest – October 2024
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that LURKS WITHIN WALLS will be part of Steam Next Fest, taking place from October 14th at 10 AM PDT to October 21st. This is your chance to dive into the game's eerie atmosphere and face its terrifying creatures before the official release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239070/LURKS_WITHIN_WALLS_Demo?snr=1_5_9__18

[h2]What to Expect:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A chilling survival horror experience set in claustrophobic environments
[*] Combat terrifying creatures illustrated by Trevor Henderson
[*] Revive the atmosphere of classic horror titles
[/list]
Don't miss the chance to experience the demo at Steam Next Fest!

Meanwhile, join our Discord Server and follow us on [url=https://linktr.ee/2wedges]Social Media[/url] to don’t miss a thing.
